Credentials leak every day (Meli et al., 2019). Mobility traces are unique (de Montjoye et al., 2013), as shown before (Meli et al., 2019).

2. de Montjoye, Y.-A., Hidalgo, C. A., Verleysen, M., & Blondel, V. D. (2013). Unique in the Crowd: The privacy bounds of human mobility. _Scientific Reports_, _3_, 1376. https://doi.org/10.1038/srep01376
